description: A PostHog subscription: a scheduled delivery of an insight, a dashboard or an AI-generated report to email, Slack or Microsoft Teams.

Mode.description: What the report analyzes each run: `since_last_sent` (default, everything since the previous scheduled delivery), `last_n_days` (a trailing window of StartDaysAgo days) or `days_ago_range` (from StartDaysAgo to EndDaysAgo days ago).

StartDaysAgo.description: Lower bound of the analysis window, in days before the run. Required for `last_n_days` and `days_ago_range`. 1-365.

EndDaysAgo.description: Upper bound of the analysis window, in days before the run (0 = now). Required for `days_ago_range` and must be less than StartDaysAgo. 0-365.

Window.description: Analysis window for the report. Omitted means `since_last_sent`.

DashboardId.description: ID of a dashboard that grounds the AI report. Set exactly one of DashboardId and InsightId.

InsightId.description: Numeric ID of an insight that grounds the AI report. Set exactly one of DashboardId and InsightId.

PostAllInsightsInMainMessage.description: Slack subscriptions only. Insight and dashboard subscriptions: upload all insight images in the main Slack message instead of threading the rest. AI report subscriptions: post the chart images in the main message with the summary. Defaults to false.

IncludeImages.description: AI report subscriptions only: include generated chart images. Defaults to true.

IncludeFeedback.description: AI report subscriptions only: include report feedback links. Defaults to true.

IncludeManageLink.description: AI report subscriptions only: include a link to manage the subscription. Defaults to true.

IncludePosthogHint.description: AI report subscriptions only: include PostHog product guidance (rendered in Slack only). Defaults to true.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the subscription belongs to.

Insight.description: Numeric ID of the insight to deliver. Set exactly one of Insight, Dashboard and Prompt.

Dashboard.description: ID of the dashboard to deliver. Set exactly one of Insight, Dashboard and Prompt.

DashboardExportInsights.description: Numeric IDs of the dashboard's insights to include (max 20). Required for dashboard subscriptions.

Prompt.description: Free-text prompt that drives an AI-generated report. Set exactly one of Insight, Dashboard and Prompt.

AiPromptConfig.description: Configuration for AI report subscriptions (only valid with Prompt).

Contexts.description: Up to 3 dashboards and insights that ground an AI report (only valid with Prompt).

TargetValue.description: Recipient(s): comma-separated email addresses for email, a Slack channel name or ID for slack, or a Microsoft Teams webhook URL for teams. PostHog only returns the host of a Teams webhook URL; the template value is kept when it matches.

IntegrationId.description: ID of the connected Slack integration. Required when TargetType is slack.

Interval.description: Interval multiplier (e.g. 2 with weekly frequency means every 2 weeks). Defaults to 1.

Byweekday.description: Days of the week for daily or weekly subscriptions.

Bysetpos.description: Position within the Byweekday set for monthly frequency (e.g. 1 for first, -1 for last).

Count.description: Total number of deliveries before the subscription stops. Omit for unlimited.

StartDate.description: When to start delivering (ISO 8601 date-time). Anchors the recurrence and may be in the past. Deliveries run on half-hour cycles at :00 and :30.

UntilDate.description: When to stop delivering (ISO 8601 date-time). Omit for indefinite.

Enabled.description: Whether the subscription is active. Set to false to pause delivery. PostHog sets it to false when the delivery integration becomes invalid. Defaults to true.

InviteMessage.description: Optional message included in the invitation email sent to new recipients. Write-only.

SendTestNow.description: Deliver the subscription once immediately when it is created or updated. Defaults to false (unlike the PostHog API, whose default on create is true). Write-only.

SummaryEnabled.description: Attach an AI-generated summary to each delivery (insight and dashboard subscriptions only). Requires the organization to have approved AI data processing.

SummaryPromptGuide.description: Free-text guidance steering the AI summary (insight and dashboard subscriptions only).

DeliveryConfig.description: Per-delivery rendering options. Each option applies to one subscription kind or delivery target only.

ResourceType.description: What the subscription delivers: `insight`, `dashboard` or `ai_prompt`. Derived from Insight, Dashboard or Prompt.

InsightShortId.description: Short ID of the delivered insight, for insight subscriptions.

NextDeliveryDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the next scheduled delivery.
